parameters.command: cd "${SCHEMASHIFT_ROOT:-.}" && python3 -m schemashift reverse-inspect --db artifacts/sample/demo.sqlite --out artifacts/n8n-reverse/inspection.json

cd "${SCHEMASHIFT_ROOT:-.}" && python3 -m schemashift reverse-infer --inspection artifacts/n8n-reverse/inspection.json --forward-map artifacts/sample/schema_map.json --out artifacts/n8n-reverse/model.json

cd "${SCHEMASHIFT_ROOT:-.}" && python3 -m schemashift reverse-similarity --inspection artifacts/n8n-reverse/inspection.json --model artifacts/n8n-reverse/model.json --out artifacts/n8n-reverse/similarity.json
cd "${SCHEMASHIFT_ROOT:-.}" && python3 -m schemashift assist --proposal artifacts/n8n-reverse/model.json --similarity artifacts/n8n-reverse/similarity.json --out artifacts/n8n-reverse/assistant.json

parameters.jsCode:
const approved = $json.approved === true || $json.approved === 'true' || $json.query?.approved === 'true';
return [{ json: { approved } }];

parameters.errorMessage: Reverse schema was not approved. SQL data remains unchanged.

parameters.command: cd "${SCHEMASHIFT_ROOT:-.}" && python3 -m schemashift reverse-freeze --model artifacts/n8n-reverse/model.json --similarity artifacts/n8n-reverse/similarity.json --out artifacts/n8n-reverse/schema_map.json --approve
cd "${SCHEMASHIFT_ROOT:-.}" && python3 -m schemashift reverse-generate --map artifacts/n8n-reverse/schema_map.json --out artifacts/n8n-reverse/generated
cd "${SCHEMASHIFT_ROOT:-.}" && python3 -m schemashift reverse-export --db artifacts/sample/demo.sqlite --map artifacts/n8n-reverse/schema_map.json --out artifacts/n8n-reverse/documents
cd "${SCHEMASHIFT_ROOT:-.}" && python3 -m schemashift reverse-verify --db artifacts/sample/demo.sqlite --map artifacts/n8n-reverse/schema_map.json --out artifacts/n8n-reverse/documents
